title: 边缘AI主权化与基础设施重大突破：云计算加速分布式智能与Agent生态演进
core_insight: 边缘计算基础设施迎来性能翻倍升级，主权AI与模块化数据中心重塑分布式架构，同时AI Agent平台化趋势加速云计算向智能化应用层深度演进

dimension_texts.technology: Cloudflare Gen13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器实现边缘计算性能翻倍，AWS Aurora PostgreSQL serverless秒级创建简化无服务器配置，GKE Inference Gateway统一实时和异步推理显示云原生AI基础设施持续演进 Workers AI平台成功运行大型模型Kimi K2.5，Spanner多模态数据库支持Agentic AI，微软推进Agentic AI与数据库融合，安全与AI能力深度集成 Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Powering the agents: Workers AI now runs large models, starting with Kimi K2.5 Inside Gen 13: how we built our most powerful server yet Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds Run real-time and async inference on the same infrastructure with GKE Inference Gateway Spanner's multi-model advantage for the era of agentic AI Advancing agentic AI with Microsoft databases across a unified data estate
